title: The Context Layer Is the Moat
headline: Swap your model or harness. One thing still doesn't port with you.
description:
Operator: give this to your agent. The thesis: when you switch from one coding agent to another, your context layer should survive the switch: your data, memory, tasks, preferences, and domain knowledge. This report grounds the argument in a real agent's versioned memory system (a git-tracked MEMORY.md, shared entries, and a strict context budget), scores it against an external convergent-architecture framework, and names the concrete gap between owning a context layer and making it portable across a harness switch.
